meta.title: CYPECAD 2023 reference results - Muelle de Trasmallo 40 m module (Anejo 10, Cullera)
meta.source_file: report/A10_CALC_ESTRUCTURAS.docx (Apéndice 1, via a Markdown conversion not kept in the repo)

units.note_torsor: beam listing section 2 labels Torsor unit as [kN] (sic); it is a torque, kN·m

meta.null_meaning: null = cell shown as '--' (no value) in the CYPE listing, or NOT FOUND in sources

pile_head_loads_1_4_5.note: Loads applied at pile heads (listing 1.4.5). P10, P12, P16, P21 have NO entry (not loaded). P9..P20 CHS 'pilares' (group 1-1, no external support) carry only the Tiro bolardo / Tiro Bolardo 2 / Tiro bolardo 3 loads listed. Sign as printed; axes = pile local axes (Ang=0 => global X,Y). Mx/My naming follows CYPE per-hypothesis convention (see conventions).

ELU_cimentaciones.title: E.L.U. de rotura. Hormigón en cimentaciones

combinations_1_6_2.note: Blank cells in the source = coefficient 0 (hypothesis absent). TB1='Tiro bolardo', TB2='Tiro Bolardo 2', TB3='Tiro bolardo 3'. Wind partial factors (1.6.1) are applied to the three Tiro bolardo hypotheses (1.4.2 declares them as wind hypotheses).

beams_listing_2.note: ELU design envelopes (CYPE 'Listado de armado de vigas'). x = distance from start of tramo (first-named support); tramo lengths are CLEAR spans between support faces (pile-pile 3.05 = 3.45 - 0.40; pórtico 10 6.10 = 6.50 - 0.40), so x=0.00 is at the pile FACE. The drawing peaks (beams_diagram_labels_from_images) and the main-body N,M value (-273.71 'en P3') are larger than the x=0.00 table value (-266.03) -> they refer to the support region/axis, not the face. Pórtico 2 does not exist in the listing. Pórtico 1 (25x30, y=-0.45) is ONE tramo P9-P20 (39 m) with 1/3L zones spanning 13 m each. Transverse pórticos 3..9 have a 0.10 m tramo from the CHS bollard 'pilar' (P9..P21) to the first pile and a 3.05 m tramo pile-to-pile (3.45 m axis spacing). Deflections: F.Activa and F.A plazo infinito (quasi-permanent).

beams_diagram_labels_from_images.note: Peak labels read visually from the envelope diagrams (My, Vz) in the beam drawings media/image203-212. My min at the first pile (P1,P3,P5..) is larger in magnitude than the listing 'Momento mín' at x=0.00 of the pile-pile tramo; the drawing peak coincides with the main-body design value -273.71 (P3-P4). Pórtico 1 labels are tiny raster text: LOW confidence.

Pórtico 1.confidence: LOW (blurry raster); support/span values -32.84, -28.85, 25.61, 21.05, -33.25, 30.96, 30.54 agree with text table; last-span end shear label partly unreadable ('-27.?3')

pile_forces_by_hypothesis_3_3.note: Line 4947: 'Los esfuerzos están referidos a ejes locales del pilar.' Tramo 0.00/6.70 m: Base = z 0.00 (fixed base), Cabeza = z 6.70 m (top of the column tramo, NOT the 7.00 deck level). Values rounded to 0.1 in source.

pile_base_forces_arranques_3_4.note: Line 5037: 'Los esfuerzos están referidos a ejes locales del pilar.' Base (arranque, z=0) forces per hypothesis; identical to the 'Base' columns of 3.3.

pile_pesimos_3_5.note: Worst-case design forces. Notes line: 'Q: agotamiento frente a cortante / N,M: solicitaciones normales'. Naturaleza 'G, V' = PP+CM+1.5·Tirobolardo (ELU comb 5); 'G, Q, V' = 1.35·PP+1.35·CM+1.05·Qa+1.5·Tirobolardo (ELU comb 8) (combination names given in 4.2 notes). ATTENTION: Mxx here = 'My' of 3.3/3.4 and Myy = 'Mx' of 3.3/3.4 (verified). Rows flagged Q are FIRST-ORDER forces; rows flagged N,M (and Arranque) include CYPE second-order/imperfection amplification (main-body P3: first-order MEd,x=288.36 vs MSd,x=353.51).

pile_elu_checks_4_2.note: Arranque rows: Disp./Arm. N.P.(1) 'La comprobación no procede'. Mxx/Myy convention as in 3.5.

beam_checks_4_3.note: Resistance: 'x' location or support, eta = aprovechamiento %. Deflection limits: fT L/250, fA L/500, quasi-permanent. Cracking: all N.P.(1) (tension below fct) -> CUMPLE.

text_paragraph_line_74.raw: En los cálculos se han obtenido las siguientes reacciones máximas para los pilotes de 400 kN de compresión y 125 kN de tracción en ELS y de 590 kN de compresión y 220 kN de tracción. Valores inferiores a las 105 tn (1050 kN) el tamaño del pilote viene condicionado por su resistencia a flexión con las cargas de los amarres.
text_paragraph_line_74.note: The sentence does not say 'ELU' explicitly for 590/220 ('...y de 590 kN de compresión y 220 kN de tracción'). These values are NOT reproducible from the Apéndice 1 listing (see derived_by_extractor.text_claims_check).

slab_capacity_1_10.note: P25-1..P25-5 positive ultimate moments 158.7/220.6/221.2/235.5/240.2 kN·m/m; negative per reinforcement 45.3..156.1 kN·m/m (line 4603)

viga_cantil.raw: Se dispone en el armado del cantil 420 y cercos 10/0.10 a efectos de la carga de atraque tenemos una losa de 5 cm de capa de compresion y 4.65 que actua como diafragma y transmite las cargas de los atraques a los dinteles principales. El momento debido al atraque es de 410 kNm tomando una luz de 6.50 m. Con una anchura de 4.65 m las tracciones en los extremos son de 410/4.65 = 83 kN.  La resistencia a traccion de 420 son 4*314*400 N = 502 Kn que resisten adecuadamente las cargas de atraque.

derived_by_extractor.WARNING: Everything in this block is computed by the extractor from the listing (3.3/3.4 values rounded to 0.1 kN / kN·m). Not printed by CYPE. Linear superposition, first order.

moment_shear_pairing.method: L_implied = -(M_cabeza - M_base)/Q for rows with |Qy|>=5 kN or |Qx|>=1.5 kN (values rounded to 0.1 => scatter for small Q)
moment_shear_pairing.conclusion: In 3.3/3.4 Mx pairs with Qx and My pairs with Qy with M_cabeza - M_base = -Q*6.70 (tramo 0.00/6.70). i.e. CYPE 'Mx' = bending in the X-Z plane (moment vector about local y), 'My' = bending in Y-Z plane (vector about x).

pesimo_reproduction.conclusion: Q rows (first order) are reproduced within rounding by PP+CM+1.5TB -> confirms Mxx(3.5)=My(3.3), Myy(3.5)=Mx(3.3), same sign. N,M rows reproduce N,Qx,Qy exactly but moments are amplified (2nd order + imperfection + minimum eccentricity in the weak direction).

second_order_increment.conclusion: Where the listing moment differs from the first-order combination, the difference is |dM| = N x ~0.105 m in BOTH directions (= ei 12.94 mm + e2 ~92 mm of the main-body A19.5.8.8 check, lines 571/584). Tension piles (N<0) are never amplified. Some 'Q' rows (P3 Pie, P5 Cabeza/Pie, P7/P13/P15 Pie) also carry the amplified moments; P1/P3/P7/P13/P15/P16 Cabeza Q rows are first order.

equilibrium_vs_3_7.note: 3.7 is the resultant of the loads acting above the base (per its own text, line 5198); compare with sums of 3.4 base forces (rounding 0.1 per pile).

effective_height_of_head_loads_from_3_7.note: 3.7 My = sum(N*y) + sum(My) + sum(Qy)*z. z_eff = 7.25 m matches the 'Forjado 1 (0 - 7.25 m)' length in 3.5/4.2; 7.25 - 0.55 (beam depth) = 6.70 = 3.3 tramo. So in this CYPE run the head loads act at z=7.25 above the pile base although 1.7 gives Forjado 1 at cota 7.00. VERIFY before fixing SAP geometry.

combination_envelopes_first_order.note: N>0 = compression (CYPE sign: PP gives positive N). Combination numbers refer to the family's own table in 1.6.2.

text_claims_check.conclusion: Line-74 reactions (400/125 ELS, 590/220) do not match any combination family of the Apéndice 1 listing; they probably stem from a different model run (cf. main body heading 0-7.00 m vs listing 0-7.25 m). The main body NEd,max = 673.90 kN (line 302) DOES match ELU comb 10 at P3 base.

pile_selfweight_between_base_and_head.note: 40x40 at 25 kN/m3 = 4.0 kN/m -> 6.55 m; OR 6.70 m (tramo length) x 0.16 m2 x 24.525 kN/m3 (2.5 t/m3 x 9.81, CYPE default) = 26.29 kN. The second reading is consistent with the 6.70 m tramo; the main body (PESO PROPIO) states 25 kN/m3.

conventions.local_axes: 3.3 and 3.4 state 'Los esfuerzos están referidos a ejes locales del pilar' (lines 4947, 5037). All piles have Ang=0.0 (1.8.1), so local x,y = global X (along the quay, 0..39 m) and Y (transverse, 0..3.45 m; bollards at Y=-0.45).
conventions.axial: N > 0 = compression (Peso propio gives N>0). Tiro bolardo gives +N on the y=0 row piles (P1,P3,P5,P7,P13,P15,P16) and -N (tension) on the y=3.45 row (P2,P4,P6,P8,P14,P17,P18).
conventions.per_hypothesis_tables_3_3_3_4: Mx pairs with Qx and My pairs with Qy (verified: M_cabeza - M_base = -Q x 6.70 m for all rows with |Q|>=5). Example P1 'Tiro bolardo': Qy=-51.9, My base -177.9 / head +169.7 (difference 347.6 = 51.9 x 6.70); Mx base 5.2 / head -8.6 goes with Qx=2.1. So CYPE 'My' here is the moment acting in the Y-Z plane (vector about local x) produced by the transverse (Y) bollard pull.
conventions.check_tables_3_5_4_2: 'Mxx' and 'Myy' = moments ABOUT the x and y axes: Mxx(3.5/4.2) = My(3.3/3.4), Myy(3.5/4.2) = Mx(3.3/3.4), same sign. Main-body: MEd,x pairs with ee,y (465.06 mm) and VEd,y.
conventions.sap2000_mapping_hint: SAP2000 default for a vertical frame: local 1 = +Z, local 2 = +X, local 3 = +Y (verify in the model). Then CYPE (Mx, Qx) [X-Z plane] <-> SAP (M3, V2); CYPE (My, Qy) [Y-Z plane] <-> SAP (M2, V3); CYPE Mxx(3.5/4.2) <-> SAP M2, Myy <-> SAP M3. Signs differ between programs: compare magnitudes and the base/head sign pattern (bollard pull gives opposite-sign moments at base and head).
conventions.base_force_sign: 3.4 arranque forces are the actions of the pile ON the foundation: sum of base Qy for Tiro bolardo = -691.1 = sum of applied head loads (-691.0, pull towards -Y). N>0 compression. SAP support reactions will therefore have the opposite sign for shears (F2 = +691 total) and F3 = +N for compression.
conventions.moment_sign_rule_3_3: M(z) = M_base - Q*z along the pile (z from base). A head load Q applied e above the head gives M_head = Q*e (1.4.5 bollards: Qy=-75, My=-37.5 -> e = 0.50 m).
conventions.positions: 3.3: Base = z 0.00 (fixed), Cabeza = z 6.70 (tramo 0.00/6.70). Pésimos 3.5/4.2: Pie/Cabeza of 'Forjado 1 (0 - 7.25 m)' plus 'Arranque' (cimentación). Main body: 'FORJADO 1 (0 - 7.00 M)', l0 = 6.700 m.
conventions.second_order: 3.5/4.2 rows with Pésima 'N,M' and Arranque rows include slenderness amplification (A19.5.8.8) - do not compare with linear SAP output directly; compare Q rows or recompute from 3.3.
conventions.beam_listing: Beam moments: negative = hogging (top tension); x measured from the first-named support of each tramo.
conventions.sums_3_7: Referred to origin X=0,Y=0: 3.7 Mx ~ sum(N·X)+..., My ~ sum(N·Y)+..., T ~ sum(X·Qy - Y·Qx): see derived_by_extractor.equilibrium_vs_3_7.
